statement: 4 batch(es) 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-16, clock-skew correction on: 994 normalized events from 1018 records (13 duplicates merged, 11 quarantined). 8 incident(s): 2 critical, 4 high, 2 medium. Evidence gaps: host_auth declared 2026-10-14T13:45Z to 2026-10-14T16:15Z; resource_access silent 2026-10-16T09:40Z to 2026-10-16T14:31Z. Synthetic data: every event, entity and label was generated for a fictional organisation. Detector metrics measure agreement with synthetic labels and do not estimate real-world performance.
